description: Parent POM updated to include Spring Cloud Azure BOM (v7.4.0) for managed identity support. The dependency management section correctly imports the BOM with scope 'import' to manage Azure-related transitive dependencies. This version is compatible with Spring Boot 4.1.2 (the target version from task 002).

Web module POM updated with three new dependencies: (1) spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql for passwordless authentication, (2) H2 database with test scope for unit tests, (3) spring-boot-starter-data-jpa-test with test scope for @DataJpaTest support. All test dependencies are correctly scoped and will not leak into production. The existing postgresql driver (runtime scope) is retained.

Production configuration migrated from local PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with managed identity authentication. Original code (localhost:5432 with hardcoded credentials) replaced with: (1) externalized POSTGRESQL_SERVER, POSTGRESQL_PORT, POSTGRESQL_DATABASE environment variables, (2) mandatory TLS (sslmode=require), (3) passwordless enabled (spring.datasource.azure.passwordless-enabled=true), (4) managed identity enabled (spring.cloud.azure.credential.managed-identity-enabled=true), (5) optional AZURE_MANAGED_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID for user-assigned identities. Extensive comments document configuration options for different Azure clouds and authentication scenarios. No credential is hardcoded. Application database principal (POSTGRESQL_USERNAME) is distinct from operator identity, as required by task specification.
Worker module POM updated with the same three new dependencies as web module for consistency and feature parity. All test dependencies are correctly scoped. No issues identified.

Production configuration migrated identically to web module. Same managed identity, TLS, environment variable externalization, and documentation as web module. Configuration is consistent across both modules.

New test class validates that production datasource configuration meets security and Azure requirements. Test methods: (1) datasourceUrlTargetsAzurePostgresqlFlexibleServerOverTls() verifies endpoint is Azure service with sslmode=require, (2) noDatabasePasswordIsConfigured() verifies no password in config and passwordless is enabled, (3) managedIdentityAuthenticationIsEnabled() verifies managed identity flag, (4) applicationDatabasePrincipalIsExternalizedNotHardcoded() verifies principal is supplied via environment (${...} placeholder), not hardcoded. Tests only parse properties file without opening database connection. All assertions are well-reasoned and directly support the migration requirements.

New repository-facing integration test verifies that Spring Data JPA operations preserve entity behavior after datasource migration. Uses @DataJpaTest and in-memory H2 database (never connects to live Azure database). Test methods: (1) savesAndRetrievesEntityPreservingS3PathMetadata() verifies CRUD and metadata fields (S3 URL, thumbnail URL), (2) updatingEntityRefreshesLastModifiedButKeepsUploadedAt() verifies timestamp behavior is preserved, (3) findAllAndDeleteBehaveLikeStandardJpaRepository() verifies standard JPA operations. Tests verify that existing application behavior is preserved after managed identity migration. All assertions use AssertJ fluently.

Test-only configuration that overrides production settings for unit tests. Points to in-memory H2 database (jdbc:h2:mem:assets_manager_test) in PostgreSQL compatibility mode (MODE=PostgreSQL). Correctly disables managed identity (spring.cloud.azure.credential.managed-identity-enabled=false) and passwordless mode (spring.datasource.azure.passwordless-enabled=false) since tests run without Azure credentials. This isolation ensures unit tests do not require Azure environment or credentials to run. Hibernate DDL is set to create-drop for clean test isolation.

Identical to web module DataSourceConfigurationTest. Validates production datasource configuration meets security requirements (TLS, managed identity, no hardcoded credentials, externalized principal). No issues identified.
Identical to web module ImageMetadataRepositoryTest. Verifies repository behavior and S3 metadata preservation using in-memory H2 database. No issues identified.

Test-only configuration for worker module. Identical to web version except database name (assets_manager_worker_test) for test isolation. Correctly disables Azure-specific configuration for unit tests. No issues identified.
Metadata file updated with 'status': 'started' for task 003. This is a tracking change, not code change. No functional issues.
